snippet.title: Ancient Farm - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Ancient Farm is now available on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933930/Ancient_Farm/

This relaxing farming simulator takes place in ancient Egypt during the time of the pharaohs. Players can farm, raise animals, forage, build, craft, and cook. In 2026, the game will also be available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

#AncientFarm #FarmingSimulator #FarmSim #Farming
